title: RowReadDeferred
description: Data of the internal -32014 refusal from a paged stored-rows read (ADR-y45sp41c, refining ADR-8eej3e66 §7 for this one retry). The connection had no read slot free, so it neither queued the request without bound nor closed the socket: it answered at once, and the renderer's own priority queue waits this long before sending the most urgent request it holds at that moment. A person never meets this answer; a client that does is expected to retry, not to report a busy state.

retryAfterMs.description: How long to wait before offering another stored-row read.
